'''2009 Coruscant Regionals James Booker LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' James
* '''Username:''' Paul
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
